name: Board
tagline: Real-time collaborative whiteboard with sticky notes, shapes, and layer ordering
description:
A snappy collaborative whiteboard built to replace heavy Miro boards. Supports custom shapes, sticky notes, pencil drawing, multiplayer pointers, and organization workspaces.

Vibecoded with Cursor and Liveblocks over a weekend sprint, using Convex for backend reactivity and Clerk for multi-tenant organizations.

replaces.note: Lightweight sticky-note board with instant multiplayer cursors and infinite undo/redo.
